args.title: Bellwether warehouse automation (2026) — combined summary
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts in 2026 warehouse automation deployments.
- Integration took twice as long as planned, offsetting some of the expected gains.
- Per the subscriber companion piece, the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse and its subscriber companion (https://insights.bellwether.example/warehouse/companion).
